activity.notes: Vardan Mamikonian was the Armenian sparapet and leader of the anti-Sasanian Armenian struggle, dying at Avarayr in 451. Because primary 'opposes' relations are not allowed in Human Authoring and 'serves' would invert the historical meaning, ATLAS uses the neutral `active_in` relation to the Sasanian imperial context for the decisive 451 military Activity.

sources.title: Vardan Mamikonian — Central Bank of Armenia collector coin
sources.citation_text: The Central Bank of Armenia identifies Vardan Mamikonian as Armenian Sparapet, supreme commander, and leader of the struggle against the Persian Sassanid Empire; he died at Avarayr in 451.

sources.title: Vardan, Mamikonian, St. — Encyclopedia.com
sources.citation_text: The encyclopedia identifies Vardan as an Armenian noble and leader of the uprising against Yazdgard II, with death at Avarair in 451.
